type: Global student technology ambassador pathway with AI learning/activity milestones
intake_status: Active official registration pathway. Registration is not an application or immediate official membership; participants complete self-paced activities and qualifying people are invited to onboard.
eligibility_country: Global/all disciplines except Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Sudan, Syria, Russia, Belarus and Crimea; requires 18+, full-time accredited higher-education enrollment and Azure for Students. India is not listed among excluded locations.
fit: Strong potential fit if user is full-time and has/obtains Azure for Students; user is over 18 and B.Tech ECE, with all disciplines welcome.
evidence_notes: Microsoft FAQ says registration then activity requirements, followed by invitation/onboarding. Benefits after onboarding include certificates/badges, Microsoft Teams, Office 365, Visual Studio Enterprise and monthly Azure credits; April 2026 Microsoft announcement states $150 monthly Azure credits. Distinct from paid Microsoft Copilot Student Ambassador. No registration performed.
